fixed.summary: A <For> without `key` keys an object item by its `id` (else the item itself, as before), so a keyed collection a view model makes afresh on every change keeps its rows, their entrances and their state. About seventy built-in lists over { id } items passed no key and made every row again on each update: StarRating's lit stars replayed their pop and never showed on a results screen, and Results' counted stats restarted.
